text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 5342109876 — p95 latency elevated for embeddings service in eu-west-1. Auto-runbook triggered: https://runbook.internal/embeddings-p95. Paging #eng-oncall and #eng-sre.

alice-oncall: Acknowledged. Seeing p95 jump ~200ms -> ~1.2s for last 6m, error rate stable, request rate unchanged. KV proxy eviction rate increased on nodes kv-7/8/9.

ben-eng: On it. Suspect KV eviction + hot-shard causing tail latency. I'll start targeted drain + restart of kvproxy on kv-8, then rebalance. Rolling now (kv-8 -> kv-7 if needed).

emma-sre: Recommending short-term traffic steering: add temporary routing rule to divert 10% of eu-west-1 traffic to eu-central-1 for embeddings to relieve pressure. I can push if we agree.

carla-support: Which customers are most likely to see impact? Any paid SLAs affected? Need to prep CS notification.

alice-oncall: Top affected tenants by 95th: acme-inc, learnco, helpdesk-pro. All in standard plan, not SLA-exempt. ETA for mitigation 8-12 mins after kv-8 restart. Will draft status and customer note.

ben-eng: kv-8 restart complete. Observed eviction rate drop ~60%. p95 trending down from 1.2s -> 550ms.

alice-oncall: Drafting status page update now. Copy below — please thumbsup/edits:

```
Status: Partial degradation — Read/embedding latency (eu-west-1)
Impact: Some customers in eu-west-1 may see elevated p95 latency for embeddings (up to ~1.2s). Throughput and correctness unaffected.
Mitigation: We have restarted a degraded kvproxy node and enabled cross-region spill to eu-central-1 for 10% of traffic. Engineers are monitoring.
ETA: 30 minutes for full normalization, will update sooner if resolved.
```

alice-oncall: Draft customer-facing note (short):

```
Hi — we detected elevated latency for the embeddings service in eu-west-1 affecting some customers. We have taken steps to reduce impact (node restart and limited cross-region spill) and are monitoring. No data loss or errors. Next update within 30 minutes or as we have a resolution.
— Redwood Inference Status
```

dave-product: Language ok. Suggest adding a sentence: "If you rely on strict latency SLAs for production traffic please contact support and we'll prioritize remediation for your tenancy."

marta-cs: Approving send to affected customers once we confirm p95 < 600ms for consecutive 2 mins. Will prepare ticket templates for ACME and LearnCo.

carla-support: I'll queue the templates and set priority flags. Please ping when we have steady p95.

ben-eng: p95 now ~400ms and steady for last 90s. Continuing to watch KV eviction histogram.

alice-oncall: :white_check_mark: p95 stable < 600ms for 2m. Sending status page update and customer note now. Will leave thread open for 1h of monitoring, then close with post-incident summary.

incident-bot: Incident 5342109876 status changed to "Mitigated". Follow-up: owner=alice-oncall, postmortem-due=+72h.
